External fibre break. — procedure

Fictional provider procedure; not an operational instruction for a real network.
Scope: fibre_broadband; support category: broadband_outage.
First inspect the reported checks and do not repeat an already completed check without a reason.
Diagnostic gate: Agent optical test reports no received signal; account is active.
Only if that finding is established: Raise a fibre repair job; an authorized technician repairs the external span.
If the finding is absent, ask for missing observations or route for investigation; do not assume the cause.
Completion criterion in this simulation: optical signal restored and wired browsing works.
Restriction: Do not factory-reset the router or tell the customer to handle exposed fibre.
